what_it_fixes: Main mission 2 step 'Register at least five species' (2_1_50), its two lab triggers (trigger_main_02) and Mable's 46 'Filling Your Pokedex' requests (5..230) count only the Lumiose Pokedex list. With the patch, have_pokemon_encyclopedia_total_condition counts Lumiose + Hyperspace (Mega Dimension) caught species, each species once (the lists are disjoint, 232 + 132), and the mission panel's 'Number Registered N/M' shows the same number.
not_changed: Pokedex screens and the DLC's own Hyperspace dex progress (have_dimension_encyclopedia_total_condition, panel item type 18)
save data, flags, DLC unlock: nothing is written; no DLC Pokedex force-open (not needed: DLC species caught before the DLC are already registered - PKHeX-verified on PC)

existing_runs: Works for existing runs without any save change: the count is computed live from the save's Pokedex, and DLC species already caught are already registered there (PKHeX-verified on PC), so earlier DLC catches count immediately (no need to re-catch).

klog_lines.evaluator: [dexcount] have_pokemon_encyclopedia_total condition: lumiose=L hyperspace=H combined=L+H (call N)
klog_lines.panel: [dexcount] mission panel Number Registered: lumiose=L hyperspace=H combined=L+H (call N)
klog_lines.note: one line per entry point only when (L,H) changes; also written to stderr (runtime log file if any). No line = the hooked function did not run yet.

console_test_steps: 0. Usual install rules (verified save backup first, .new/readback/rename/readback, never restore an old save over newer progress). Watch klog (port 3232) during the test.

1. Use the existing run (Continue) or a new run; no table changes or special wild slots are needed - just catch DLC (Mega Dimension / Hyperspace) species near the start; with the randomizer they appear in the first zones anyway.

2. If main mission 2 is at 'Register at least five species': open the main menu (X). The mission panel must show 'Number Registered' = Lumiose + DLC species caught (before the fix it showed only the Lumiose ones). klog: '[dexcount] mission panel Number Registered: lumiose=.. hyperspace=.. combined=..'.

3. With combined >= 5, walk to the Pokemon Research Lab marker: the mission must advance (lab scene, step 'Go report your Pokedex-filling success'). klog: '[dexcount] have_pokemon_encyclopedia_total condition: ... combined=>=5'. With combined < 5 the 'not yet' dialog must still appear.

4. Mable's requests (main menu, research requests from Mable, available after mission 2): a 'Filling Your Pokedex (NN)' request must show/complete with Lumiose + Hyperspace caught; the 'Filling Your Hyperspace Pokedex' requests (if visible) must still count only Hyperspace species.
5. Save in-game, close, Continue: the numbers must be the same (nothing is stored by the fix). Optional: PKHeX check of the save copy - only normal gameplay changes.
6. Report: screenshots of the panel before/after, the klog lines, the mission advancing.
rollback: Link with the original liblasgame-r28.a and without za_dexcount.o (= r28 behaviour). The fix stores nothing in saves, so rollback needs no save change.
